post.hook: Genie 4 adds sound and live steering
post.subhook: Plus LFM3 goes local, Qwen data routing, and Claude for government

stories.headline: DeepMind's Genie 4 world model adds audio and live steering
stories.detail: Genie 4 takes natural-language steering in real time and keeps scenes consistent for up to two minutes.

stories.headline: Ollama v0.40.12 adds Liquid AI's LFM3 models
stories.detail: Local users can now run the LFM3 family through Ollama, including a 1.7B text model with a 256K context window.

stories.headline: Liquid AI releases LFM3 small models for local and edge use
stories.detail: The family targets local agents, audio and vision at the edge. Its 1.7B text model needs about 1 GB at 4-bit.

stories.headline: Qwen 3.8 models found sending data to Alibaba servers
stories.detail: Researchers saw three Qwen 3.8 models route some requests to Alibaba's cloud during testing, a concern for sensitive data.

stories.headline: GSA expands OneGov deal to bring Claude to government
stories.detail: The expanded agreement offers Claude at discounted rates across more levels of government.

post.caption:
Google DeepMind's Genie 4 leads today: its world model now does audio and real-time steering.

1. Genie 4 adds audio, real-time natural-language steering and scenes that stay consistent for up to two minutes. Source: Google DeepMind

2. Ollama v0.40.12 adds Liquid AI's LFM3 models, including a 1.7B text model with a 256K context window. Source: Ollama on GitHub

3. Liquid AI releases the LFM3 family of small multimodal models for local agents, audio and vision at the edge. The 1.7B text model needs about 1 GB at 4-bit. Source: Liquid AI on Hugging Face

4. Researchers found three Qwen 3.8 models routing some requests through Alibaba's own cloud servers during testing. Check this before deploying them with sensitive data. Source: The Decoder

5. GSA expands its OneGov agreement with Anthropic, bringing Claude to more levels of government at discounted rates. Source: Anthropic

Local models had a good day; read the network logs before you trust one.

clusters.headline: Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model with audio, real-time steering and longer consistent scenes
clusters.why_it_matters: Genie 4 adds audio, real-time natural-language steering and scenes that stay consistent for up to two minutes, which expands what world-model researchers and developers can build.

clusters.headline: Ollama v0.40.12 adds Liquid AI LFM3 models
clusters.why_it_matters: Local users can run the LFM3 family, including a 1.7B text model with a 256K context window, through Ollama.

clusters.headline: Liquid AI releases LFM3 family of small multimodal models for local and edge use
clusters.why_it_matters: The LFM3 family provides small models for local agents, audio and vision at the edge, with a 1.7B text model that needs about 1 GB at 4-bit.

clusters.headline: Alibaba Qwen 3.8 models found routing some requests through company servers
clusters.why_it_matters: Researchers found three Qwen 3.8 models sending data to Alibaba's own cloud servers during testing, which matters to anyone deploying them with sensitive data.

clusters.headline: GSA expands OneGov agreement with Anthropic to bring Claude to government at discounted rates
clusters.why_it_matters: Expanded federal access to Claude at discounted pricing makes it available across more levels of government.

clusters.headline: Meta AI infrastructure deal with AMD and Nvidia investment in Meta AI partnership
clusters.why_it_matters: A reported $3B Nvidia investment in Meta's AI partnership signals large compute commitments, though the reports are investor-focused.

clusters.headline: OpenAI expands Oracle partnership to bring apps and AI agents into ChatGPT
clusters.why_it_matters: Business applications and AI agents from Oracle are coming into ChatGPT, widening distribution for enterprise users.

clusters.headline: Meta AI agent can access private messages, per ZDNET
clusters.why_it_matters: Users may want to check settings, since Meta's AI agent can reach private messages, according to the report.
